description: A research lab is receiving concentrated Hydrogen Peroxide (>60%, UN 2015, CAS 7722-84-1) and needs a storage compatibility assessment. Use CAMEO Chemicals at https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/ to: (1) find the Hydrogen Peroxide (>60%) datasheet, (2) identify ALL reactive groups it belongs to, (3) use the CAMEO reactive group compatibility chart to find which other groups are incompatible, and (4) cross-reference the incompatible groups with the chemicals currently in Room 215 (listed in ~/Desktop/storage_compatibility_query.txt). Save a comprehensive compatibility report to ~/Documents/h2o2_compatibility_report.txt including: reactive groups for H2O2, all incompatible groups, which specific Room 215 chemicals are hazardous near H2O2, and storage recommendations.
